mapper.select: SELECT u.* FROM follow f JOIN users u ON f.followee_id = u.user_id WHERE f.follower_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follow(follower_id, followee_id, created_at) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follow WHERE follower_id=#{followerId} AND followee_id=#{followeeId}
